description: This file defines a report parser class for generating crossovered budget reports in an OpenERP/Odoo module, including methods for calculating budget figures and totals.

classes.name: budget_report
classes.description: Report parser class for crossovered budget report, handling data processing and calculations for report generation.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Constructor initializing the report parser and setting up local context variables.

methods.name: funct
methods.description: Calculates detailed budget data, aggregating figures per analytic account and budget line, returning a list of result dictionaries.

methods.name: funct_total
methods.description: Returns total aggregated budget figures as a list with a single dictionary.
